name: test_TC023_post_midnight_early_morning_indexing[chromium]
description:
12:xx AM cards must appear at the top of their day's appointment list.

    A 12:00 AM meeting is seeded for tomorrow. This Week always includes tomorrow,
    so the midnight card appears. We verify it exists and is not the last item.
descriptionHtml:

A 12:00 AM meeting is seeded for tomorrow. This Week always includes tomorrow,

statusMessage:
AssertionError: 12:xx AM card is at the last position (3/3). Expected it to lead its day group.
assert (3 < (4 - 1) or 4 == 1)
statusTrace:
dashboard = <pages.coachPortalPages.Appointment_on_DashBoard_page.AppointmentDashboardPage object at 0x7f5635c867b0>

    def test_TC023_post_midnight_early_morning_indexing(
        dashboard: AppointmentDashboardPage,
    ) -> None:
        """12:xx AM cards must appear at the top of their day's appointment list.
    
        A 12:00 AM meeting is seeded for tomorrow. This Week always includes tomorrow,
        so the midnight card appears. We verify it exists and is not the last item.
        """
        dashboard.select_this_week_filter()
        cards      = dashboard.appointment_cards
        card_count = dashboard.get_appointment_card_count()
    
        assert card_count > 0, (
            f"No appointments in This Week — seed may have failed. "
            f"Expected at least '{MIDNIGHT_SEED_TITLE}'."
        )
    
        midnight_indices = [
            i for i in range(card_count)
            if re.search(r"12:\d{2}\s*AM", cards.nth(i).inner_text())
        ]
        assert midnight_indices, (
            "No 12:xx AM card found in This Week. Check that the midnight seed was created."
        )
    
        first_midnight = midnight_indices[0]
>       assert first_midnight < card_count - 1 or card_count == 1, (
            f"12:xx AM card is at the last position ({first_midnight}/{card_count - 1}). "
            "Expected it to lead its day group."
        )
E       AssertionError: 12:xx AM card is at the last position (3/3). Expected it to lead its day group.
E       assert (3 < (4 - 1) or 4 == 1)
